## Goal
`letter_vars` (`engine/letters.py:127-196`) includes the name, city, state, age, street, zip and phone only when a listing shows that field (`Listing.shown_fields`) and, for the phone, only with permission. That is the "data minimization" promise in the module docstring (`letters.py:1-9`) and POSITIONING. Tests only: for a seeded set of random subsets of `ProfileField`, build listings that show exactly that subset, render every template in `letters.TEMPLATES` that applies (`generic_removal`, `ccpa`, `state_privacy`, `follow_up`, `legal_demand`, `postal_letter`) and assert that no value of an unshown field appears in the text. Fix nothing here; a leak is a finding with file:line and a strict xfail (a follow-up code WO fixes it).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. 200 seeded subsets (`random.Random(20261109)`), each rendered through all six templates, never raise and never contain the sentinel for a field outside the subset: street, zip, city, state name, age, phone, date of birth, relatives, personal email.
2. The middle name appears only when `ProfileField.MIDDLE_NAME` is shown (SEC-29 rule, `letters.py:141-143`).
3. The age that appears is the listing's own `age_shown`, never one computed from the birth date (SEC-115, `letters.py:153-156`): use a profile whose computed age differs from the shown age.
4. The phone appears only if shown AND `allow_phone_disclosure` (test both False cases).
5. The removal mailbox is the only email address in any letter; the personal email sentinel never appears.
6. A blind request (no listings) includes the name and mailbox only, plus city/state only if the caller passes them via the existing rules (assert exactly what `letter_vars` returns for no listings).
7. The seed and the failing subset are in the assertion message so a failure reproduces.
8. Offline; no files outside `tmp_path`.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
